conditions: Every planned file change is realized or explicitly routed back to Planning.
All candidate Genesis normative changes have been applied to repository-level accepted authority exactly once.
Canonical repository Conformance returns PASS with no authority, coverage, result, or execution-closure defect.
All required Planning and Build Assurance review cases have PASS disposition.
Build mutation manifest contains no unplanned path.
The accepted-state record identifies the accepted Genesis repository revision without requiring prototype provenance.
FS0-GENESIS functional-set and Plan artifacts remain present and unchanged by state promotion except for changes explicitly authorized by a later Plan.

A normal successor framework functional set can bind the accepted Genesis state, select remaining Design statements, produce an accepted Plan, build, validate, assure, and advance accepted state without a Genesis-specific semantic bypass.
The initializer product has not been implemented as part of Genesis.

README.md exists at repository root and accurately describes the portable Genesis seed, FS0-GENESIS/framework versus FS0-CORE/product distinction, canonical validation entry point, and successor functional-set workflow.
AGENTS.md exists at repository root and gives non-authoritative contributor guidance consistent with accepted authority and Design/Planning/Build responsibility boundaries.
LICENSE exists at repository root with the complete GNU General Public License version 3 text required for portable reuse.
Every Genesis Design input resolves to a preserved snapshot whose SHA-256 digest matches its exact bytes and whose selected statement identities resolve within that snapshot.
Genesis Design-input verification succeeds from a copied repository tree without requiring the prototype repository, prototype commit objects, or prototype branch ancestry.
The ordinary successor-framework proof does not require duplicated Design Proposal snapshots when a governed repository-native exact revision binding is resolvable.
Canonical repository Conformance establishes evidence closure: every executable assertion resolves to and satisfies its governed evidence obligations.
The derived FS0-GENESIS repository initial commit is recorded as the root repository provenance revision and post-Genesis lineage resolution requires no ancestry before that commit.
The basic CI workflow checks out the exact candidate revision, invokes repo/scripts/validate as the sole canonical Conformance entry point, and contains no independent normative predicate logic.
For pull-request candidates, remote Governance binding verifies that the governed review surface identifies the exact candidate revision before its CI result is used as acceptance evidence.
Conformance evidence registry data persisted under repo/ contains evidence identity/obligation correspondence rather than per-run CI evidence payloads.

Planning and Build Assurance findings used for acceptance remain historically resolvable from governed issue/PR evidence surfaces to exact candidate revision, review case, obligations, evidence basis, and disposition.
No maintained repository Assurance artifact is used as the per-candidate historical finding or review-receipt store.
Local repo/scripts/validate remains operable without GitHub API availability; hosting-platform evidence augments governed lifecycle provenance rather than replacing canonical local Conformance.
